description: End-to-end telecom tariff change management workflow, from designing and simulating new tariff plans to approvals, rollout, monitoring, and rollback.

tariff_id.description: Unique identifier for a tariff plan (product catalog level).

tariff_version_id.description: Identifier of a specific version of a tariff plan within its lifecycle.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a tariff change management request.

simulation_id.description: Identifier for a pricing and impact simulation scenario.

approval_workflow_id.description: Identifier for the approval workflow instance associated with a change request.

deployment_batch_id.description: Identifier for a deployment batch of subscribers impacted by a tariff change.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a rollback plan prepared for a tariff change deployment.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: list_tariffs
functions.description: List existing tariffs with filtering by status, product type, and lifecycle state.

status.description: Current operational status of the tariff.

has_pending_change.description: Whether tariff has any pending change requests.

created_by.description: Filter tariffs created by a specific user ID.

functions.returns: Paginated list of tariffs matching the filter with summary details (id, name, status, latest_version, key attributes).

functions.name: get_tariff_details
functions.description: Get detailed information about a specific tariff and its versions.

tariff_id.description: Identifier of the tariff to retrieve.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response.

version_filter.description: Filter which versions to include when 'versions' is requested.

effective_on.description: Only include versions effective at a specific timestamp.

functions.returns: Full tariff metadata including structure, current and historical versions, and optionally eligibility rules, discounts, and audit log.

functions.name: create_tariff_change_request
functions.description: Create a new tariff change request (new version or new tariff) with proposed modifications.

source_tariff.description: Reference to an existing tariff/version if the change is not creating a brand-new tariff.

requested_by.description: User or system ID requesting the change.

target_markets.description: Markets/regions where this change will apply.

proposed_tariff_definition.description: Definition of the new or modified tariff structure.

pricing_components.description: Array of pricing components that make up the tariff.

usage_tiers.description: Usage tiers if component is tiered.

items.description: Tariff IDs that cannot be combined with this tariff.

discounts.description: Optional discount rules associated to the tariff.

items.description: Name or ID of pricing component this discount applies to.

duration_months.description: If defined, discount expires this many months after activation.

requested_effective_window.description: Requested effective period for the change.

risk_assessment.description: Initial risk assessment from the requester.

functions.returns: New change_request_id along with initial status, linked tariff/tariff_version if any, and a summary of the proposed changes.

functions.name: simulate_tariff_change_impact
functions.description: Run revenue and customer impact simulations for a proposed tariff change.

change_request_id.description: Identifier of the change request to simulate.

simulation_scope.description: Defines which subscriber base or segment is simulated.

segment_definition.description: Optional criteria to define simulation segment.

sample_size.description: Number of subscribers in sample if scope_type is sample_subscribers.

assumptions.description: Assumptions for churn, upsell, and usage elasticity.

churn_delta_percentage.description: Expected percentage change in churn rate.

upsell_takeup_rate.description: Expected percentage of customers who will move to higher plans.

functions.returns: simulation_id and summarized projected KPIs (revenue, margin, ARPU, churn impact) with breakdowns per segment and time period.

functions.name: submit_tariff_change_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a tariff change request into a formal approval workflow.

approval_workflow_template.description: Name or ID of the approval workflow template to use.

required_approvers.description: Explicit list of approver roles or user IDs in sequence stages.

approver_id.description: Role name or user ID depending on approver_type.

min_approvals.description: Minimum approvals required at this stage if multiple approvers are defined.

comments.description: Optional notes from the submitter to approvers.

functions.returns: approval_workflow_id and updated change request status (e.g., pending_approval), including approval stages and current pending stage.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_tariff_change
functions.description: Approve or reject a tariff change at a particular approval stage.

approver_id.description: User ID of the approver taking action.

stage_name.description: Name of the approval stage this action applies to.

requested_changes.description: If action is request_changes, list of change requests.

field_path.description: JSON pointer or field path for the requested change.

functions.returns: Updated approval workflow status, overall decision if final stage, and updated change request status (approved/rejected/changes_requested).

functions.name: schedule_tariff_deployment
functions.description: Schedule deployment of an approved tariff change, including phased rollout strategy.

rollout_phases.description: If deployment strategy is phased or pilot_then_full, define rollout phases.

percentage.description: Percentage of base if population_type is percentage_of_base.

subscriber_list_id.description: Reference to a precomputed subscriber list.

segment_criteria.description: Criteria to dynamically determine subscribers in this phase.

guardrails.description: Automatic stop conditions for this phase.

change_freeze_exceptions.description: Whether this deployment has an approved exception to change freeze windows.

pre_deployment_checks.description: List of checks that must pass before deployment can start.

functions.returns: deployment_batch_id (for the first or main batch), created rollout schedule, and updated change request status (e.g., scheduled).

functions.name: execute_tariff_deployment_batch
functions.description: Trigger execution of a specific deployment batch/phase and track initial results.

initiated_by.description: User or system ID initiating the batch.

dry_run.description: If true, run validations only without applying changes.

override_guardrails.description: Whether to override pre-configured guardrails (requires privilege).

functions.returns: Updated deployment batch status (queued/in_progress/completed/failed), summary of validations, and counts of subscribers to be migrated.

functions.name: get_tariff_change_status
functions.description: Retrieve status of a tariff change request including approval, deployment, and monitoring indicators.
functions.returns: Overall change request lifecycle status, with optional detailed approval status, batch statuses, KPI evolution, and linked incidents or rollback plans.

functions.name: prepare_tariff_rollback_plan
functions.description: Create a rollback plan for a tariff change, including rollback conditions and target state.

target_state.description: Definition of what state subscribers should be returned to.

fallback_tariff_id.description: If previous tariff is not available, use this fallback tariff.

preserve_discounts.description: Whether to preserve current discounts when rolling back.

rollback_conditions.description: Conditions under which rollback will be triggered.

min_revenue_uplift_pct.description: If uplift falls below this value, rollback may be triggered.

items.description: Roles allowed to manually trigger rollback.

communication_plan.description: Basic outline of how rollback will be communicated to subscribers.

functions.returns: rollback_plan_id and status of the rollback plan (draft/approved), with a summary of rollback conditions and target state.

functions.name: trigger_tariff_rollback
functions.description: Trigger execution of an existing rollback plan for a tariff change.

initiated_by.description: User or system that is triggering rollback.

reason_details.description: Additional free-text explanation of the reason.

dry_run.description: If true, only compute impact without applying rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback execution status, impacted subscriber counts, and linkage to any created incidents or problem records.

functions.name: retry_failed_tariff_deployment_operations
functions.description: Retry or remediate failed subscriber-level operations from a deployment batch.

error_filter.description: Filter which failures to retry when retry_scope is by_error_code.

manual_selection.description: List of subscriber IDs to retry when retry_scope is manual_selection.

remediation_actions.description: Optional corrective actions to apply before retry.

initiated_by.description: User or system ID initiating the retry.

functions.returns: Summary of retried operations, remaining failures, and updated deployment batch error statistics.

functions.name: cancel_tariff_change_request
functions.description: Cancel a tariff change request if it has not yet been fully deployed.

force_cancel.description: If true, attempt to cancel even if partially deployed (may require rollback).

functions.returns: Cancellation result (success/failed/partial), updated change request status, and any recommended rollback or clean-up actions.

functions.name: search_tariff_change_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across tariff_change entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching tariff_change entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_tariff_change_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N tariff_change records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_tariff_change_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many tariff_change records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_tariff_change_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many tariff_change records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_tariff_change_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of tariff_change data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_tariff_change_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a tariff_change dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_tariff_change_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more tariff_change entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_tariff_change_snapshot
functions.description: Restore tariff_change state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_tariff_change_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the tariff_change workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_tariff_change_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across tariff_change metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_tariff_change_audit_events
functions.description: Search the tariff_change audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_tariff_change_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers tariff_change workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_tariff_change_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for tariff_change events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_tariff_change_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for tariff_change events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_tariff_change_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off tariff_change job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_tariff_change_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled tariff_change jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_tariff_change_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled tariff_change job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_tariff_change_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a tariff_change operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_tariff_change_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a tariff_change action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_tariff_change_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a tariff_change approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_tariff_change_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any tariff_change entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_tariff_change_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a tariff_change entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_tariff_change_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling tariff_change behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_tariff_change_policies
functions.description: List tariff_change policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_tariff_change_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two tariff_change-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_tariff_change_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a tariff_change entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_tariff_change_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many tariff_change entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
